subject.title: feat(models): make per-agent model allowlist explicit; aliases/defaults no longer restrict

question: Should the feature retain the new per-agent `modelPolicy.allow` API after the session-patch repair, with a maintainer-reviewed compatibility proof across every override entry point?
rationale: The PR adds a persistent public configuration surface and migration semantics; the mechanical Gateway repair is clear, but acceptance of the permanent configuration contract remains a maintainer product and compatibility decision.

options.title: Repair and retain explicit policy
options.body: Propagate `sessionAgentId` through session-patch model validation and review the new policy/migration contract across all override surfaces before merge.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Retain the alias/default decoupling but defer per-agent policy support if maintainers do not want to establish this new public configuration contract now.

recommendation.title: Repair and retain explicit policy
recommendation.body: Propagate `sessionAgentId` through session-patch model validation and review the new policy/migration contract across all override surfaces before merge.
